gaps.valueSet: Rule 7 completed test results versus laboratory orders
gaps.reason: SEM_V1 laboratory evidence cannot distinguish a completed observation from an order; the three source all-test-results branches are represented by test value-set membership
the source identifies birth-certificate maternal-syphilis and death-certificate syphilis evidence, but SEM_V1 has no birth- or death-certificate evidence
